clauses.text: Eligible participants are 18 years or older.
clauses.title: Minimum age

clauses.text: Eligible participants have HbA1c up to 9.0%.
clauses.title: HbA1c eligibility ceiling

clauses.text: Hold the dose if ALT is above 3x ULN.
clauses.title: Dose hold — liver enzymes

clauses.text: Notify the medical monitor the same day a dose is held.
clauses.title: Notify medical monitor

clauses.text: If a visit is missed, reschedule within 7 days.
clauses.title: Missed visit window

clauses.text: Participants must fast 8 hours before labs.
clauses.title: Fasting before labs

title: Fictional Phase 2 study of an oral therapy in adults with a chronic condition
